ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic hooks and heavy guitars fit the mix I enjoy in Chuck and Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: Archetype; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its heavy riffs and melodic passages sound especially appealing alongside my recent In Flames listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Music for Speeding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-focused instrumental music interests me, but I am choosing vocal-led albums this time.

ItemID: NA; Title: Cryptic Writings; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its riff-driven metal appeals to me, but other albums here fit my current mood more closely.
ItemID: NA; Title: Silence in Black & White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic, emotional rock could suit my interest in The Reason, but heavier music feels more appealing today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Winterheart's Guild; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal sound interests me, though I am less drawn to its prominent keyboards right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Toxicity; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose its intense vocals, unusual rhythms, and memorable hooks after enjoying Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days.
